Subject: Biannual check-ins: manager notes and handling of a sensitive case

Hi all,

As we start the biannual review window, I want to align on two items: manager notes for the calibration meeting and one sensitive case that needs HR coordination. Please: 

- Upload your short manager write-ups (bullet summary, impact, development areas, suggested calibration band) to the shared folder by EOD Thursday (link below).
- If you have anything that touches potential performance improvement plans (PIP) or termination risk, do NOT include those specifics in the shared folder. Instead, reply-all here with a single line asking HR to open a private thread and then send the details directly to HR only.

Context: one IC on infra (I can discuss name offline) has recurring stability/ownership gaps that are borderline for a formal PIP. I want to ensure we follow process and legal guidance before escalating. Stephanie/Neha — please confirm the required steps and whether we should loop legal.

Attachments: manager_notes_guidance.pdf (short template and redaction examples).

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xY-Org-Review-2026

Proposed schedule: calibration working session — Thu Nov 19, 2:00–3:30pm PT. If that time conflicts, flag it now.

Thanks — short and practical notes please.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
People Lead, Platform
Redwood Inference

- Sensitive case: one engineer has had two missed roadmap commitments and several postmortem action items not closed. I believe performance conversation should start before formal PIP. 

I agree we should not put the full notes into the shared folder. I'll send Stephanie a private note now with the details and timeline I have.

On Thu at 2pm I can present a 6-min summary and proposed calibration band.
